name: TB Debug Small
details: The instructions explicitly require a package `mathutils` with an `add` function that adds two numbers. The failing test asserts `add(2, 3) == 5`, which is directly specified by the task. Since all packaging/PEP 732/editable-install tests pass and only the arithmetic result is wrong, the failure is due to an implementation error (normal agent limitation), not missing or ambiguous task instructions.
